findings.evidence: Rule check: "4 channel(s) not assigned to a sample: TMT132C, TMT133N, TMT133C, TMT134N". The description says: "Four channels are unused." The SDRF has 12 samples on a TMTpro 16-plex kit.
findings.explanation: The 12 samples take 12 of the 16 TMTpro channels, so 4 are empty. This matches the description, which says 12 samples and four unused channels. The empty channels will carry no sample signal, so the analysis should not treat them as samples. They may only add background or noise-level reporter ions. The likely cause is that the 12-sample design does not fill a 16-plex kit, so this is expected and not a labelling error.
findings.suggested_fix: No change to the SDRF is needed. Confirm that the four channels (TMT132C, TMT133N, TMT133C, TMT134N) were left empty and exclude them from quantification.

summary: The SDRF agrees with the description on cell line, organism, disease, trypsin digestion, TMTpro 16-plex labelling, 12 samples, and the 2 antibody x 2 treatment x 3 replicate layout. The only rule issue, the four unused channels, is expected from the description and is reported as an explanatory warning.
